card.name: Digits inside prices and quantities
card.fires_on: Digits (often a first or second digit) inside amounts such as prices, volumes in mL and recipe measures, especially just before more digits or a unit. Also fires on a dollar sign or 'per' after a price.

modes.label: Digits in prices
modes.description: A digit or dollar sign inside a price figure such as $75 or $30.

modes.label: Digits in volumes and doses
modes.description: A leading digit in an mL volume or dose amount, often followed by another digit or a fraction.
modes.example: Recommended dose: 100 milligrams (<<1>>5 mL) per administration

modes.label: Recipe amounts
modes.description: A digit starting a recipe quantity or fraction before a unit.

card.plain: It marks a number being written out, such as a price, a volume or a recipe amount, where more digits or a unit are likely to follow.
